FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Stats Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a couple new stats to influence resource production.

patchNoteLines.li: Add workerProductionBase and workerProductionMultiplier to easily modify production for all of a settlement's resources

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Building slot fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Actually respect the max building slot count specified by a WorldSettlementDef

patchNoteLines.li: When calculating a settlement's max building slots, enforce the settlement type's def as a hard cap

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.
